criterion: A socketable is a rule changer when a main (not Bonded) line of it changes how a mechanic works, not how much of it you have: it grants a keystone or Culling Strike; makes a mechanic apply where it otherwise doesn't (all Physical damage Pins, Strikes Splash, all damage builds Electrocution, minion attack speed modifiers affect you, Warcries explode corpses, Overkill damage spreads, melee damage taken is reflected); fixes or reshapes a roll (Lucky Block, a fixed base Critical Hit Chance, only the minimum or maximum damage, no Critical Damage Bonus); lifts a cap or an allowance (maximum Quality, suffixes, crafted modifiers); changes the item (transforms its modifiers, opens a modifier pool, turns its sockets into a Jewel socket); switches a mechanic off (can't Evade, unaffected by Slows, can't be Ignited, all damage bypasses Runic Ward); or sends a whole mechanic elsewhere or adds a spend (Charges going to or shared with allies, Mana regeneration also recovering Runic Ward, attacks spending Runic Ward). It is not one when it adds or scales a number, a share of one stat or pool counting toward another included (X per Y, N% of A applies to B, damage from a stat or from the enemy's Power, part of the damage taken from another pool), or when it gives an ordinary effect on hit, critical hit or block (Maim, Bleeding, Aggravation, Intimidate, a curse). Raven-Touched Shard and Legacy of A Worthy Foe name effects their text doesn't explain, so they wait for a lookup.

ruleChangers.idol-of-kraityn: in a sceptre, Frenzy Charges you would gain go to allies in your Presence instead
ruleChangers.emergent-vigour: in boots, hits against you have no Critical Damage Bonus while you're on Consecrated Ground

ruleChangers.warding-rune-of-equinox: in a caster weapon, 40% less Mana regeneration, which also recovers Runic Ward

ruleChangers.breath-of-aldur: in a weapon, its Fire and Lightning modifiers become equivalent Cold ones
ruleChangers.ire-of-aldur: in a weapon, its Fire and Cold modifiers become equivalent Lightning ones
ruleChangers.betrayal-of-aldur: in a weapon, its Fire, Cold and Lightning modifiers become equivalent Chaos ones
ruleChangers.rune-of-culmination: in a one-hand mace or quarterstaff, Physical damage rolls only its minimum or maximum
ruleChangers.rune-of-consistency: in a helmet, your hits lose their Critical Damage Bonus for 200% increased Critical Hit Chance

ruleChangers.cadigans-epiphany: in gloves, their augment sockets are destroyed to make a Jewel socket
ruleChangers.astrids-creativity: any equipment may have one more crafted modifier
ruleChangers.voranas-carnage: a helmet can roll Berserking modifiers
ruleChangers.thruds-might: a weapon can roll Destruction modifiers
ruleChangers.medveds-tending: a body armour can roll Soul modifiers
ruleChangers.legacy-of-bramblejack: in a body armour, 250% of the melee Physical damage you take is reflected to the attacker
ruleChangers.legacy-of-ashrend: in a body armour, you can't be Ignited
ruleChangers.legacy-of-crown-of-thorns: in a helmet, grants the Pain Attunement keystone
ruleChangers.legacy-of-ezomyte-peak: in a helmet, grants Unwavering Stance

ruleChangers.legacy-of-bushwhack: in boots, your Physical damage Pins

ruleChangers.legacy-of-the-knight-errant: in boots, grants the Iron Reflexes keystone
ruleChangers.legacy-of-svalinn: in a shield, Block is Lucky but blocked hits still deal 20% of their damage
